## WordCraft egui 0.37 migration additions

@skylartaylor contributed the `Delete Around Caret in Equation` row in `bg`, `cs`, `da`,
`de`, `es`, `et`, `fr`, `hr`, `hu`, `it`, `ja`, `ka`, `ko`, `nl`, `pl`, `pt-br`, `ro`,
`ru`, `sl`, `sr`, `sr-latn`, `sv`, `tr`, `uk`, `vi`, `zh-hans` and `zh-hant`. The original 26 rows were prepared in the unpublished WordCraft migration and moved
here after the app adopted shared catalogs. The same command label was then added
to the Georgian catalog. The revised wording names the caret within the
equation, where the command deletes adjacent editing units. They were written from
the English meaning; no native-speaker review is recorded. They are separate from the earlier catalog
migrations and translator credits above.

## WordCraft: Arabic rows for newer interface strings

@tlomts-dev contributed 70 Arabic (`ar`) rows to `locales/ar/wordcraft.tsv` for strings in current WordCraft code that had no row yet (recovery copies, update check, custom document properties, pane menu, spelling-dictionary messages, Print page choices, tracked-change shortcuts and similar), AI-assisted with Claude Code and written from the plain meaning of the English, in the terminology already used by the file. No other product's localisation was consulted. @salehnemari-max, the catalog's Arabic author and a native speaker, read all 70 rows line by line, asked for three wording changes (four rows, applied before the merge) and approved the PR. A follow-up wrote four rows for the macro dialog (`Macro name:`, `Record…`, `Stop Recording` and its empty-list message), moved the recovery rows to the term `استرداد`, reworded the Print scaling rows, and removed three update-check rows that WordCraft no longer uses; @salehnemari-max read these changes as a native speaker, approved them, and asked for one agreement fix (`ما زال` in the local-recovery row), which is applied.

## WordCraft: Arabic number agreement

Saleh Hassan Alnemari (@salehnemari-max), AI-assisted with Claude Code (Opus 5.5), reworded 12
Arabic (`ar`) rows in `locales/ar/wordcraft.tsv` whose counted noun had one form for every number
(the status bar read "4 من 4 كلمة"), so they read correctly for any count: the noun first as a
label, or the partitive `{n} من …`. The translator, a native speaker, read the 12 reworded rows and approved them.

Bogdan Claudiu Petanec (@multipointmaster-glitch), with Codex assistance,

## Language data

Every file under `language-data/` ([ADR 0004](docs/adr/0004-third-party-language-data.md),
[ADR 0005](docs/adr/0005-language-data-lives-here.md)), with its author, source, licence and
Licence class. Upstream files are kept unmodified. These rows moved here with the files from
WordCraft (`wordcraft@a88e00525`, `assets/hyphenation/` and `assets/spelling/`), byte for byte.
The checker (`crates/craft-i18n-tests/tests/language_data.rs`) fails when a file has no row or
more than one, a row has no file, the licence is empty or copyleft that can't be embedded (LGPL,
GPL, AGPL, CC-BY-SA), or the class isn't Embeddable. The licence table was signed off on
2026-11-01 ([ADR 0004](docs/adr/0004-third-party-language-data.md)). Language packs aren't
committed: `language-data/manifest.toml` records each pack file's source, licence and class
([format](docs/language-data-format.md)). `language-data/licences/<SPDX id>.txt` are the standard
licence texts from [spdx/license-list-data](https://github.com/spdx/license-list-data) @
`31846481de7ea17d92f2f46fad76abe58b2e9bb0`, copied verbatim as each licence permits.

| File | Author | Source | Licence | Licence class | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `language-data/en-us/hyphenation.pat` | DesignCraft contributors (generated) | trained from the Moby list by DesignCraft's patgen | Public Domain (CC0-1.0) | Embeddable | Our own Liang hyphenation patterns (no TeX patterns) |
| `language-data/en-us/en-us.dic` | Grady Ward (Moby Hyphenator II word list); converted by DesignCraft contributors | https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/3204 (file `mhyph.txt`, SHA-256 `eeb30474c86b8af3469035ec1a0913e35905325ca885290db9dfed9881e230ac`), via DesignCraft | Public Domain | Embeddable | ~165k words with break points; drives spelling and hyphenation |
